query: How does RCU detect that a grace period has completed so it can safely free old data?

matches.reason: Core kthread loop that polls rcu_node qsmask and forces quiescent states, breaking out precisely when it detects the grace period has ended.
Finalizes a detected grace-period end by advancing gp_seq via rcu_seq_end() and propagating completion to all rcu_node structures.
Moves callbacks whose grace period has completed into the done sublist, which is the step that makes it safe to invoke/free the old data.
The fundamental sequence-number comparison primitive used to decide whether a grace period has completed since a given snapshot.
